answer: For 2025 Schneider Electric reported 1,944,796 m3 of total water withdrawals other than cooling, 874,433 m3 from water-stressed areas, estimated withdrawal coverage of 85%, and intensity of 48.4 m3 per million euros. A further 890,844 m3 withdrawn for cooling and returned without impact was measured separately and excluded from performance calculations.
